collection.title: Skoda Octavia Estate 2012 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Skoda Octavia Estate Mk3 2012 - 2019 will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Skoda Octavia which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
